requiredBehavior.A_quantity_order_independent: All 5 phrasings parse to the same formal quantity=300. Quantity is an independent structured slot of the current utterance, not proof-by-intent-regex. First turn missing quantity → WAITING_INPUT; next turn replying only '300台' must resume the pending readiness task and must not ask again.
requiredBehavior.B_semantic_admission: Single-recipe readiness meaning maps to the readiness goal regardless of trigger phrase: 生产100台缺什么料 / 缺料预览…100台 / 100台齐料怎么样 / 按100台看缺料 all enter the same family. Must not require the literal token 生产…台 and must not require the user to say the internal family name.
requiredBehavior.C_no_quantity_shortage: V750…缺什么料？ must NOT fall into the cost domain. Allowed: WAITING_INPUT asking 请告诉我要按多少台计算, or the existing formal default if the contract defines one. Never guess a quantity.
requiredBehavior.D_multi_recipe: Do NOT add multi-recipe readiness. If the formal contract is single-recipe, give a bounded clarification e.g. 当前一次按一个配方做齐料预览。请先选择 V750 或 V550。 Never bind the whole user sentence as recipeName. Never fuzzy first-result. Never fall into the wrong business domain.
requiredBehavior.E_domain_preserving_fallback: Readiness/shortage requests keep their domain even when Native admission fails. No drift to 当前成本/保存成本. When tool facts already exist, never output a statement contradicting them. If the question never asked about money, never emit a money-missing template.
requiredBehavior.F_no_internal_codes: CROSS_CATALOG_CANDIDATES, AI_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, formal requirement keys and internal evidence codes go to trace/log/evidence only, never into the final user answer; final answer is business language.

implementation.structuralChange: 新增 api/business-semantics/readinessSemantics.cjs 作为齐料/缺料语义与『当前话语数量槽位』的唯一权威；业务语义层（questionSemantics）与 Task V2 语义层（aiTaskSemanticsV2）共同消费，两层不可能再对业务域或数量给出不同结论。判据是业务含义（物料词 + 齐备/缺口谓词，或齐料预览类复合词，或物料词 + 数量槽位），不是句式清单。
implementation.quantitySlot: extractQuantitySlot() 从当前话语独立抽取，与词序无关；数字前必须是数量语境（行首/标点/数量介词/分配词/需求动词/型号尾字），数字后必须是数量单位。中文数量（一~九百九十九）确定性换算。正式契约无默认数量 → 永远 null，绝不猜。
implementation.multiSubject: 正式契约一次只做一个配方 → READINESS_SINGLE_RECIPE_REQUIRED 有界澄清；未新增 multi-recipe 能力；不整句当 recipeName；不 fuzzy first-result。
implementation.internalCodeLeak: missingFacts/verifiedFacts 经 businessFactText() 映射为业务语言后才进用户正文；未知内部码退化为通用措辞。
implementation.residualLimitation: 本地库无任何库存，齐料预览的可用量恒为 0；这使『短缺明细正确性』在本地只能验证结构（21 项、数量随台数线性）而不能交叉核对真实可用量。生产端 300 台缺料预览此前已独立核对通过。
